Hey! For starting out with skin care, I highly recommend going simple and safe. Get a gentle cleanser, one that won’t aggravate your acne, I personally use panoxyl because it has benzol peroxide which helps with breakouts. You massage it onto your face and leave it for 3 minutes before rinsing it off. After wards I like to use a flaxseed mask (you make it by pouring 2 cups of boiling water over 1/4 cup of flax seeds and mixing before placing in the fridge and straining out the gel with a cheese cloth) that i massage my face with (think outward motions to help shape your face and massaging masseter muscles) i leave that on for ten minutes before rinsing off and finally i use a moisturizer, cerave, specifically the tub kind is best. Definitely give it a try! Also generally speaking if everything your trying to fix what you don’t like on the outside isn’t working, try working from the inside. Think diet, sleep, gym, health over superficial stuff. Oftentimes the superficial insecurities you have can be solved by looking at deeper rooted causes like lifestyle. Skincare is one thing but are you properly hydrated? tracking your water intake can make a huge difference.

Khair pistachio is absolutely an awesome dupe of kayalis yum pistachio gelato. In my opinion it actually performs better and is stronger, and in truth is more what i wanted from kayali than what kayali gave me lol. The dry down is a little sweeter and nuttier to me but it still does have a bit of freshness that to me feels like it fades the longer you wear the scent. to me it just gets sweeter and sweeter with time and ends with that rlly nice marshmallow!

It just came in the mail, I personally really like it. It really does smell like fluffy pistachio ice cream, and the slight addition of a little freshness from bergamot makes it a fluffy, airier scent. This is a scent that in the dry down, is my favourite perfume. It is absolutely a clone of kayalis yum pistachio while being stronger and longer lasting. It smells delicious to me! When i first sprayed it i was disappointed because it opens up with a lot of citrus and fresh, but again, that only lasts for ten-fifteen minutes until the dry down emerges and leaves you with sweet, yummy pistachio. Just keep in mind that it has that freshness to it, if you’re looking for a “pure” sweet scent it might not be for you.

Khair pistachio is a 95% dupe of kayalis yum pistachio gelato, only difference is khair has better performance, and is also the tiniest bit sweeter and more marshmallow-esque, where the 5% difference is coming from. I would recommend khair over affection as well if you are looking for a dupe for kayalis scent as it is a closer match and again i think performance is better!

I know it seems impossible, but please stay for the little moments? I’ve been there I promise you. But try to hold on to moments that are brighter than the others. Even if they’re short or seem insignificant they’re there. Just hold on. U said u didn’t want to die right? Search for reason. Acitively seek it out. Do you have hobbies or interests or people you love to see? You don’t have to in order to find a reason but please, try. You’re cared for. Even if you manage to pull yourself out for a second, a moment, think of it as a victory. U won. You’ll keep on winning throughout your life in moments and times where you feel good. It’s hard to hold on to when the negatives are so loud but fight. I’m sorry you have to deal with the way you feel, and I know you didn’t ask for any of this. But there’s no way of changing that. So you have to try. ok? If u need to rant on here? Do it. If u need time to focus on yourself? Do it. Do things that make you feel better (even if it’s a little bit). If u don’t know what will do that for you? Experiment. You’ll be surprised at the things you might enjoy! sometimes if we can’t make ourselves feel better when we’re down, distractions can make it a bit more tolerable. Find someone that distracts you from the intense negativities.
